items.title: How AWS helps education leaders prioritize AI investments
items.summary: Eighteen months ago, most boards were asking leaders whether they were moving fast enough on AI. Today the question is harder: are our AI investments generating business value? Across industries, AI budgets have grown faster than the value leaders can point to, and education is no exception. Education technology (EdTech) and education leaders are spending aggressively on AI, and many struggle to tie that spend to outcomes. The numbers bear this out: McKinsey’s Enterprise AI FinOps Survey (May 2026) found that 93 percent of organizations were exceeding their AI budgets, as spend moves from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide adoption.
items.creator: Dennis McQuillan
